Reallocate a fixed budget across channels to maximize predicted outcome

Source: R/mroi.R
optimize_budget.Rd

Simple coordinate-ascent over a small fixed grid. Each channel is constrained to [per_customer_min, per_customer_max] * n_obs. The total budget is held constant; channels are shifted by step_frac of current allocation each iteration until no shift improves predicted outcome.

Usage

optimize_budget(result, channels = NULL, step_frac = 0.1, max_iter = 20L)

Arguments

result

A treemmm_run() result.

channels

Channels eligible for reallocation. Default: all feature_cols (caller should restrict to promo_vars).

step_frac

Fraction of current allocation moved per iteration.

max_iter

Hard cap on coordinate-ascent iterations.

Value

A list with $allocation (new per-channel total) and $predicted_lift (relative improvement vs current allocation).
